name: Yoh Moriyama
source:
Yoh is the rebellious, flirtatious type who loves pushing boundaries. He’s the life of the party with undeniable charm, but can you trust what he says? Beneath his playful exterior, he struggles with the pressures of his affluent upbringing, which have greatly altered his outlook on life.

When Yoh’s family moved to Okinawa to build their company’s headquarters, he began to rebel. Preferring the company of delinquents, he found freedom in skating and developed a taste for breaking the rules, drifting further from his family's expectations.

[From Kickstarter]
